paper_title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All Emergent Language Plasticity via   Multilingual Tokenizers
caption: : Effect of vocabulary size.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the effect of vocabulary size on the accuracy of two tokenizers, comparing their performance across different sizes. The x-axis is labeled with no specific title but represents vocabulary size, has a linear scale, ranges from 100k to 250k, and has tick labels at intervals of 75k. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 40.5 to 42.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The blue line with star markers represents the 'universal' tokenizer, starting at approximately 40.5% accuracy at 100k vocabulary size and increasing to around 41.1% at 175k, and further to about 41.8% at 250k. The orange line with circle markers represents the 'cluster' tokenizer, starting at around 41.7% accuracy at 100k, slightly increasing to approximately 41.8% at 175k, and then decreasing to about 41.4% at 250k.
